subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] NFS: stamp after the server's ctime when truncating under delegated times

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where the client's timestamp can be set before the server's when truncating a file under delegated times. To fix this, it raises the client's cached ctime to match the server's reply time before stamping the delegated timestamp. This ensures that the server's timestamp is always set after the client's. The patch also moves the timestamp update to the same i_lock section as the delegation check and ctime raise, preventing a potential no-op when a delegation return starts during this window.
